varAccountID.title: varAccountID
varAccountID.description: The unique Salesforce 18-character ID of the Account record associated with the meeting. This should be automatically extracted from the active page context ($Input.Account.Id) or identified by the Account Name mentioned in the user's prompt

varNoteBody.title: varNoteBody
varNoteBody.description: The raw meeting notes, text blocks, call logs, or audio transcripts provided by the user that need to be analyzed, summarized, and saved to Salesforce

varNoteTitle.title: varNoteTitle
varNoteTitle.description: The title assigned to the created note record. The agent should automatically generate this in the format 'Meeting Notes - [Account Name] - [Current Date]' without asking the user for input
